fact: The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications, with the African Union Commission, held a two-day multi-stakeholder consultation on 13-14 November 2025 in Monrovia to pave the way for developing Liberia's National Data Policy, described as upcoming and not yet adopted.

The Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications' National Data Governance Policy carries a cover reading draft, a Document Control version of Final dated March 2026, and a closing line that it will be published upon approval; the text records no approval or launch by the government.
